title: AGENTS.md vs CLAUDE.md: The Definitive Guide (2026)
summary: AGENTS.md vs CLAUDE.md explained: what each file does, which AI agent reads it, when to use each, and how to maintain both in the same project.
body_markdown: Long files consume context tokens and reduce adherence. Claude may ignore instructions buried deep in a large file. Split instructions into topic files under` .claude/rules/` , and use path-scoped rules (YAML frontmatter with a` paths` field) to load rules only when relevant files are accessed.
